title: Scaffold Risk & Escalation Sentinel agent (Phase 1, Agent #2)
spec:
Build the complete Risk & Escalation Sentinel agent per AI Factory standards. This is Phase 1 Agent #2, T2 (HITL). The directory agents/risk-escalation-sentinel/ already exists with only AGENT_CARD.md.

## Purpose
Reads Delivery Tracker JSON output, applies 5 risk rules per account, generates LLM risk summaries, and sends Webex interactive HITL cards for HIGH/MEDIUM risks.

## Trigger
Daily 8am, runs AFTER Delivery Tracker (depends on its output).

## Risk Rules (apply in order)
```
P1/P2 open > 48h                         → HIGH
SLA breach predicted within 5 days       → HIGH
Health score dropped > 15 pts in 7 days  → HIGH
Milestone slipped > 2 weeks              → MEDIUM
Entitlement < 20% with renewal < 60 days → MEDIUM
```

## Processing Steps
1. Load latest Delivery Tracker JSON from data/runs/delivery-tracker/YYYY-MM-DD.json
2. For each account, evaluate all 5 risk rules → assign tier (HIGH / MEDIUM / LOW)
3. For HIGH/MEDIUM accounts: generate risk summary + recommended action (LLM or template-based)
4. Save output: data/runs/risk-sentinel/YYYY-MM-DD.json
5. Push Webex interactive card per HIGH risk with 4 buttons:
   - [Escalate Now] → generates draft escalation text (human sends)
   - [Schedule Call] → generates draft calendar invite language
   - [Snooze 48h] → defers with reason logging
   - [Dismiss] → logs decision + reason
6. Print [METRICS] at end of run()

## Files to Create (AI Factory standard layout)
- agents/risk-escalation-sentinel/__init__.py
- agents/risk-escalation-sentinel/config.py (Pydantic BaseSettings — HELIX_API_TOKEN, WEBEX_BOT_TOKEN, WEBEX_ROOM_ID, DATA_DIR, LOOKBACK_DAYS, LOG_LEVEL)
- agents/risk-escalation-sentinel/models.py (RiskTier enum: HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW, AccountRisk, SentinelReport Pydantic models)
- agents/risk-escalation-sentinel/risk_rules.py (RiskEvaluator class — applies the 5 rules, returns List[AccountRisk])
- agents/risk-escalation-sentinel/webex_notifier.py (sends Webex card per HIGH risk with the 4-button HITL card)
- agents/risk-escalation-sentinel/sentinel.py (RiskEscalationSentinel class — trust_tier="T2", validate_inputs(), handle_error(), run())
- agents/risk-escalation-sentinel/main.py (CLI entry: --dry-run, --date flags)
- agents/risk-escalation-sentinel/tools/sentinel_tools.py (tool wrappers: evaluate_risks, get_high_risk_accounts, format_risk_card)
- agents/risk-escalation-sentinel/tests/conftest.py
- agents/risk-escalation-sentinel/tests/test_sentinel.py (trust_tier, validate_inputs, handle_error, run paths)
- agents/risk-escalation-sentinel/tests/test_risk_rules.py (one test per risk rule, happy + edge cases)
- agents/risk-escalation-sentinel/.env.example
- agents/risk-escalation-sentinel/requirements.txt
- agents/risk-escalation-sentinel/README.md

## Input Data Shape (from Delivery Tracker output)
Each account record in the JSON has: account_id, account_name, total_open, critical_high, overdue, escalated, avg_age_days, sla_status, sla_actual_pct, sla_target_pct, milestone_completion_pct, milestones_overdue

## AI Factory Class Requirements
- trust_tier = "T2"
- validate_inputs(): raises ValueError if DATA_DIR missing or WEBEX_BOT_TOKEN empty
- handle_error(exc): logs + re-raises
- run(): calls validate_inputs(), tracks records/errors, prints [METRICS] on all exit paths

## Standards
- All credentials via .env only (WEBEX_BOT_TOKEN, HELIX_API_TOKEN never hardcoded)
- HTTPS only for all Webex API calls
- Patch targets for tests: sentinel.RiskEvaluator, sentinel.WebexNotifier
- Reference ai-factory-standards.md for agent class pattern
